submission.reasoning: The alert is a false positive. It shows the normal start of the Windows Group Policy Client service on workstation5. services.exe (PID 716) launched C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s gpsvc as SYSTEM at 04:19:07Z. The binary sits in its standard System32 location and has a valid Microsoft Windows Publisher signature. Its sha256 on the process record matches the file record. After starting, it connected to the \lsass pipe and reset the Group Policy PolicyApplicationState\PolicyState values to 0 under HKLM and under the HKU hive of the RID-500 account. Both are normal Group Policy processing steps. I checked the parent, the binary, the pipe connection and both registry writes, and none of them looks malicious. I did not open the 32 loaded modules or the 10 incoming process-access events.
